message:
docs: the bad rollback points are legacy, and the same either way

The verifier audited every backup directory and the picture holds across updater
generations. The old updater needs nine files (the seven stop targets including
Setup, plus the two data files); the new one needs ten, adding the updater
itself. Both bare-version backups lack Setup, so neither generation can roll back
to them -- the list shows three and offers one, whichever updater is installed.

But it is a leftover rather than an ongoing fault. The next publish backs up the
0.2.110 pair, which has all ten, so a bare name will be a valid rollback point
again; and gate 7 now stops a manifest missing Setup from being published at all,
so this shape cannot recur. Priority stays below the in-app update work and the
server files stay untouched.
